Software Engineer II - Full-stack Developer with Anthropic Experience
jobs.description: Software Engineer II with Anthropic AI Experience, AI & Engineering/Engineering as a Service Agentic AI is moving from experimentation to production, and organizations everywhere are racing to figure out how to build it responsibly and at scale. We're growing a team of engineers who want to work at the center of that shift: designing and building autonomous, multi-agent systems powered by Anthropic's Claude models for some of the world's largest organizations. Join our AI & Engineering team in transforming technology platforms, driving innovation, and helping make a significant impact on our clients' success. You'll work alongside talented professionals reimagining and re-engineering operations and processes that are critical to businesses. Your contributions can help clients improve financial performance, accelerate new digital ventures, and fuel growth through innovation. AI & Engineering leverages cutting-edge engineering capabilities to build, deploy, and operate integrated/verticalized sector solutions in software, data, AI, network, and hybrid cloud infrastructure. These solutions are powered by engineering for business advantage, transforming mission-critical operations. We enable clients to stay ahead with the latest advancements by transforming engineering teams and modernizing technology & data platforms. Our delivery models are tailored to meet each client's unique requirements. Recruiting for this role ends on 11/1/2026. Work you'll do As a Consultant, Software Engineer II, on the Engineering as a Service team, you will be responsible for designing, building, and delivering full-stack software and AI-enabled solutions for client engagements. Design, build, test, and maintain scalable full-stack features across front-end and back-end systems. Develop and support microservices, application programming interfaces, continuous integration/continuous deployment pipelines, containerized workloads, and infrastructure as code. Integrate large language model platforms and generative artificial intelligence application programming interfaces, including Anthropic Claude, to deliver context-aware features, retrieval-augmented generation pipelines, tool-calling workflows, and automation solutions. Collaborate with product managers, designers, and engineers to translate requirements into technical solutions, estimate work, and contribute to code reviews. Troubleshoot defects, improve application performance, write automated tests, and support production readiness activities, including incident response and on-call rotations. A successful candidate would possess these skills: Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team Effective written and verbal communication skills Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product Ability to build and sustain professional relationships Ability to lead projects or workstreams Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor Ability to meet deadlines Ability to provide clear guidance to others The team Engineering as a Service provides complete design, implementation, and technology operations, leveraging our core engineering expertise. We transform engineering teams, modernize technology, and deliver complex programs with a product engineering approach. Our flexible delivery models-traditional teams, pools, or pods-are tailored to each client's needs, offering engineering-led advisory, implementation, and operational capabilities to accelerate innovation. Qualifications Required: 4+ years of professional software engineering experience with a focus on full-stack development, including 3+ years of full system lifecycle development from requirements through production deployment. 3+ years of experience designing, developing and delivering AI/ML solutions At least 6 months of hands-on experience developing agentic AI solutions using Claude Agent SDK including agent orchestration, tool integration, permissions or MCP integration At least 6 months of hands-on experience developing and deploying production solutions using Anthropic Claude models At least 6 months of experience applying prompt engineering, context engineering, structured outputs and related techniques to improve the performance, reliability and usability of AI solutions 3+ years of hands-on full-stack development experience using at least one back-end language such as Python, Java, .NET, Go, or Node.js and at least one modern front-end framework such as React, Angular, or Vue.js. 2+ years of experience in a client-facing development role, including 2+ years building and consuming Representational State Transfer (REST) and/or GraphQL application programming interfaces. Experience with at least one major cloud platform, including Amazon Web Services, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform, and one year of hands-on experience integrating Anthropic Claude application programming interfaces into software applications in a commercial setting. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Mathematics, or another technical field, or equivalent professional experience. Ability to travel 50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve. Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future. Preferred: Experience with Docker and Kubernetes. Experience with continuous integration/continuous deployment pipelines and DevOps practices. Experience working in an Agile/Scrum environment using tools such as Jira or Linear. Contributions to open-source projects or a portfolio demonstrating software development work. Industry-recognized cloud certifications such as AWS Certified Developer, Azure Developer Associate, or Google Cloud Professional Developer. Experience using Claude Cowork to support enterprise workflows, automation, research or other knowledge-work cases Hands-on experience using Claude through one of more of the following: Azure AI Foundry, Amazon Bedrock, Google Vertex AI, or the native Anthropic API The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $95,600 to $188,400. You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.
